scope: All four definitions and seven sealed signatures of the affine-loss, quadratic-potential, constant-positive-step producer chain, including its complete-Hilbert-space generalization. This is not full Theorem 15.30.
notCertified: human approval of a source repair

indexMap.source: Source rounds k=1,...,T; source state x_0 then x_k selected after receiving ell_k.
indexMap.lean: Lean rounds t=0,...,T-1; iterate t is pre-round state and prediction t = iterate(t+1).
identifications: source terminal x_T = Lean iterate T, not prediction T
indexMap.sourceInitialCondition: Algorithm 15.8 requires x_0 in int X, NOT x_0 in V. With X=E every x0 is allowed; no initial-feasibility premise is missing.

sevenSlots.name: objects_and_spaces
sevenSlots.source: V subseteq X subseteq R^d, general closed strictly convex differentiable psi and subdifferentiable extended-real losses finite on V.
sevenSlots.lean: Nonempty closed convex V in any complete real inner-product space; affine real-valued losses and psi=||.||^2/2 on E.
sevenSlots.delta: Loss and potential specialization together with ambient-space generalization; not source equivalence. Algorithm subset glyph versus theorem subseteq remains a notation ambiguity, not a silently imposed proper-subset requirement.

sevenSlots.name: quantifiers_and_order
sevenSlots.source: Every fixed u in V; rounds 1,...,T, positive eta_1,...,eta_T.
sevenSlots.lean: All sequences g,b, one fixed eta and u; natural T including zero; current-inclusive prefix agreement.
sevenSlots.delta: Reindexing is exact for positive T. T=0 is an additional Lean boundary case. Future-independent prediction_prefix is auxiliary infrastructure, not a printed source theorem.

sevenSlots.name: assumptions_regularity
sevenSlots.source: Algorithm positivity plus theorem closed strictly convex psi, interior iterates, subdifferentiability and printed eta_(t+1)<=eta_t for t=1,...,T.
sevenSlots.lean: Positive eta in four inequality/minimizer theorems; Domain fields expanded; no loss-convexity or oracle theorem imported as a binder.
sevenSlots.delta: Affine/quadratic full-domain choices discharge regularity mathematically in this specialization. General source first-order applicability and argmin-existence issues remain open; the source indexing is not repaired here.

sevenSlots.name: conclusion_metric
sevenSlots.source: Signed cumulative loss regret with negative Bregman movement; constant-step final statement drops terminal potential.
sevenSlots.lean: Signed affine loss regret with negative squared movement. Sharp bound also retains terminal squared distance.
sevenSlots.delta: regret_source_bound matches the specialized constant-step statement. regret_sharp_bound matches the stronger exact telescope before terminal discard. No claim of total regret<=0 follows.

sevenSlots.name: constants_normalization
sevenSlots.lean: All quadratic terms divided by 2 eta; no sum gradient-square penalty.
sevenSlots.delta: The factor 1/2 is exactly Example 6.5. Movement cannot generally be replaced by eta^2||g_t||^2 on a constrained domain.

sevenSlots.name: probability_feedback_stopping
sevenSlots.source: Algorithm receives full current loss before choosing x_t, then pays it. Deterministic finite horizon.
sevenSlots.lean: prediction t explicitly uses g t and is invariant to all g s for s>t. No probability, filtration, bandit oracle, or stopping time.
sevenSlots.delta: For affine losses g_t supplies the relevant loss dependence and b_t cancels. This is prescient timing, not conventional predict-before-feedback nonanticipation. No stochastic guarantees are asserted.

sevenSlots.name: boundaries_excluded_regimes
sevenSlots.source: General Bregman, nonlinear losses and varying nonincreasing steps; constant-step proof left as exercise.
sevenSlots.lean: Affine/quadratic constant-step producer, arbitrary Hilbert domains including unbounded ones; auxiliary definitions allow eta<=0, bounds do not.
sevenSlots.delta: No general nonlinear proximal producer, arbitrary mirror potential, varying-step result, full-source proof repair, BTRL result, or Chapter 2 completion.

declarations.name: advance_sharp_bound
declarations.correspondence: Single-step inequality after quadratic substitution; retains both negative terms; x may lie outside V.

declarations.name: advance_proximal_minimizer
declarations.correspondence: Constructs a feasible global minimizer for affine loss plus quadratic penalty; no arbitrary nonlinear proximal solver and no explicit uniqueness conclusion.

declarations.name: prediction_mem
declarations.correspondence: Feasibility of every produced prediction; stronger eta-domain than the positive-step source algorithm, so negative eta is not source algorithm semantics.

declarations.name: prediction_prefix
declarations.correspondence: Auxiliary deterministic prefix-invariance fact, current-inclusive s<=t. Not separately stated in source, not ordinary online nonanticipation.

declarations.name: regret_eq_loss_difference
declarations.correspondence: Affine offsets cancel exactly. All u:E and eta:R are allowed by this identity; source regret comparisons use u in V.

declarations.name: regret_sharp_bound
declarations.sourceAnchor: Theorem15.30 proof printed266 second display line
declarations.correspondence: Specialize eta_t=eta and psi quadratic in exact telescope; negative terminal residual remains. This is stronger than the final constant-step display, not its literal statement.

declarations.name: regret_source_bound
declarations.correspondence: Exact specialized constant-step endpoint with negative movement residual after dropping terminal distance. The source leaves this proof as an exercise.

successorReason: Independently reviewed the exact extraction-v2 successor. Frozen Lean signatures and semantic/binder findings unchanged; v1 review and source evidence retained.
